description: ForkSwap overlay - Modular fork management system with Web UI
compatibility: Works with ANY openpilot fork (comma official, FrogPilot, dragonpilot, etc.)
features: Web UI accessible from any device on network (port 8080)
Auto-installs Flask dependency on first run

files.description: ForkSwap Python backend and Web UI server (complete system)
Manager config with forkswapd and forkswap_webui auto-start
CLI script for command-line fork management

deployment.disable_webui: Set param ForkSwapWebUIDisabled=1 to disable auto-start
deployment.disable_service: Set param ForkSwapServiceDisabled=1 to disable backend
